title: Minimum village health rules board
summary: Creates basic public-health rules for water, toilets, waste, illness separation, and food handling.
content: Minimum village health rules board is a practical offline routine for public health governance. Write five rules: protect drinking water, separate toilets from food/water, wash hands, isolate serious illness, and keep waste away from living areas. Name who maintains each rule and the backup person. Post why each rule exists so it feels like disease prevention, not punishment. Review violations as system failures first: missing water, soap, signs, or toilet access. Update rules publicly when conditions change.
